rows.summary: Remediation round 3 for PR #491 — ONE commit round. Read the three round-3 streams in full first: `### Agent review — round 3` https://github.com/damianvtran/local-operator-ui/pull/491#issuecomment-5816952519, `### UX review — round 3` https://github.com/damianvtran/local-operator-ui/pull/491#issuecomment-5817396511, `### QA report — round 3` https://github.com/damianvtran/local-operator-ui/pull/491#issuecomment-5817830251. Design round 3 SIGNED OFF the changed surfaces at this head (#issuecomment-5817539193) — do not re-touch approved visuals except D19/n3 below.  THE TWO MAJORS, both the same root defect seen three ways: 1. **M-1 / U10 / Q1 — the expired-check reading still does not survive a reload.** Your fix reads `row.status_observed_at`, but the backend only sets that field on `live` and `probe` rows; a `stored` row has it null, and your unit test passes only because it builds a row the backend never sends. Worse, the value is in SECONDS while your code treats it as ms (a real 6-minute-old value rendered "Worked 20700 d ago"). Fix it so the claim is durable and honest without a backend guarantee: persist the memory across reloads (e.g. localStorage keyed by backend + server id, storing ms), and when there is no memory and no usable timestamp, use the row's own evidence (`tool_count_basis === "last_seen"` + `tool_count`) to say something true like "Worked earlier · N tools" under the Connected group rather than silently becoming "Ready". Never multiply/interpret `status_observed_at` unless you have verified its unit against the live payload. Rebuild the unit test from a fixture-shaped stored row, and add a test for a stored row with no timestamp and no memory. 2. **Q2 — a live Disconnect is papered over, because the backend's live read flaps.** Measured: with a chat open, 20 identical reads came back live 12 times and config-only 8 times, each under 0.5 s; the page reads once after the Disconnect, stops polling, and that read landed on the config-only answer, so the row read "Worked just now · 2 tools" with no Connect for 18 s while the backend said not connected. Fix deterministically from the UI side: a Disconnect must clear the "worked" memory for that row immediately and must not be overridden by one config-only read — e.g. keep polling the row for a short bounded window after a control action, and treat the user's action as authoritative until a live read confirms it.  The rest, batched: 3. m-1: the R2-5b pin does not catch the change it claims — the source slice runs into `liveControl`, so the regex matches that function's invalidate instead (deleting `control()`'s 409 invalidate gave 0 failures). End the slice at `const liveControl` and re-prove by mutation. 4. m-2 / Q3: a failed sign-out sits in the Connected/Ready group; it belongs under Needs attention with a primary `sign_out`. (While the page stays mounted it showed under Connected, after a reload under Available — same finding.) 5. m-3: `folderUnavailable` stays true for the whole mount, so switching to a chat whose folder is fine still shows the banner — scope it with `&& resolvedCwd === refusedCwd`. 6. m-4: the U12 focus effect stays armed until the row stops asking to sign in, so it can steal focus much later — disarm it after one refresh or a bounded timeout. 7. U14 residual: cancelling a FIRST sign-in still changes the row to "Ready / Test" under Available; a cancel must leave the row where it was. 8. U19 (this is the cause of round-1 U5): clicking Add integration with the mouse while Name is empty does nothing — the blur shows "Give it a name." and pushes the button down 25.5 px, so the click never lands (Enter works). Reserve the message's space or keep the button's position stable. 9. U15 (MAJOR, newly reachable now that Add key works): a SECOND key-only server that uses the same header dead-ends — the dialog says "Tick 'Replace saved values'" but there is no such checkbox, the stored key is named after the header so two unrelated services share `X_API_KEY`, and replacing it would break the server that works. Each server must get its own key reference (or the copy must name the real control and the replace path must be per-server), and no copy may name a control the dialog does not have. 10. U16: "Sign-out didn't finish" surfaces the backend's raw developer error — show a plain sentence and keep the technical text for the config/file view. 11. U17: with a project chat open, global rows lose their recorded state (`linear` went from "Sign-out didn't finish" to "Ready") because that folder's document returns `operations: []`; a scoped document must not erase global rows' recorded state. 12. U18: focus drops to `<body>` in four places — Cancel/Escape on the add form, confirming Sign out, a successful Save and test, and Close after a cancelled first sign-in. 13. n-1: `primaryAction`'s comment and the R2-6/U11 test title claim the key route is offered when the backend is silent; the code and the assertion say it is not (U11 is deferred) — make the text match the code. Also make the backend's "or add its key instead" reason line honest for the row it is shown on (U11's remaining contradiction). 14. n-2: `integrationsRedesignRestampNote` names the first fold but the stamp values come from the second. 15. n-3: the `invalid_target` sentence has no test. 16. n4: the rejected-key reason still shows a status code ("(401) — set its API key or headers"). 17. D19: the sign-in dialog shrinks 448→320 px on the success phase and re-centres as the user returns from the browser — `fullWidth` on the sign-in dialog. n3: both dialogs show a stray horizontal scrollbar (body 404 px inside a 398 px area) — fix alongside it. D20 (the 6 px indent the D12 trick leaves on labels/inputs) is a shared-component change: DEFER it with that reason.  RULES: every behaviour fix needs a test that fails when reverted (three of the current pins were proven not to bite). Re-run the live scenarios the round owed on the real app against a #1511 daemon: (e) reload preserving the reading, (c) live Disconnect, plus the second-key-only-server case from U15 and the empty-Name click from U19. Re-capture any changed Storybook state in both brand themes with `&args=theme:`, re-derive the manifest stamps at the committed tree, fold origin/main if DIRTY (and re-derive stamps after the fold). Then push and post `### Agent review remediation — round 3`, `### UX review remediation — round 3` and `### QA remediation — round 3`, marking every finding FIXED with the SHA / REJECTED with a reason / DEFERRED with a reason. Report head SHA, per-check CI status, comment URLs, and anything still open. Never take the operator's focus; never run `git stash` in this repo (it is shared across worktrees); reap every process by exact pid; never print a credential value.
